# Goal 3 primary research snapshot before architecture selection

**Goals 1–2 are accepted within their bounded contracts. Goal 3 is research-only: no architecture has been selected and no planner implementation, database/native execution or benchmark has run.**

This checkpoint preserves the heavy primary-source research round and recovery evidence before further work. Three original Sol 6.1 max lanes wrote 75 text files/372,185 bytes: typed-IR/SCC/SQL theory; actual unstable C API v2 and performance; correctness/safety hazards, specification corpus and acceptance matrix. Their latest logs explicitly recorded all external calls, sessions and approvals as none before the registry reconnect. Root left the original directories untouched, made a twice-hashed isolated snapshot, and resumed final evidence QA in new directories without retrying their freezers or indiscriminately repeating browsing.

## What is and is not established

The reports retain pinned d54cbbe3 source hashes, official DuckDB 2.0 references and database-theory sources, plus exact local-source identities. Questions under final QA include tagged identity versus SQL casting; case-sensitive DSL names versus SQL identifiers; eager filters after complete joins/before dedup and whole-program effects; honest route metrics; native IDB-seeding/IR boundaries; proven recursive SQL subsets; lazy fetch completion/explicit transactions; v2 accepted-filter responsibility/lifetimes; full-path benchmark endpoints and bounded scale.

Additive planned-result/explain APIs, shared native-owned logical IR, conservative total acyclic SQL and proof-scoped recursive translations versus whole-original-program fallback are **alternatives, not selected implementation**. Specification cases are UNRUN against an application. Draft wording/receipt-link corrections found during QA will be preserved as separate errata, not silently rewritten in this snapshot. A later durable selected contract and completed evidence QA must precede code. No production, speed, equivalence or ABI-stabilization claim follows from this checkpoint.
